what: Bound Dream full-model usage while retaining Flash as the default.
why: Balance inference usage and selectively test the full model when measured lift stalls.
details: Auto routing starts Flash, allows at most two full inference calls per command after eight cycles with red-cube lift below 2 cm, and returns to Flash on full capacity refusal. Actual model calls and fallbacks are logged. All 24 DreamSim tests pass. Live deployment and successful autonomous 10 cm pickup remain pending.
